blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hierarchical text detection aims to localize words, text lines, and paragraphs while parsing their structural relationships. It provides essential structural cues for visual text understanding. To maximize accuracy, existing methods typically rely on complex multi-scale feature fusion necks and heavy-weight heads, resulting in bloated architectures and low inference efficiency. In this paper, we argue that a sufficiently pre-trained backbone can effectively replace these sophisticated external modules, while simple geometric inclusion suffices for hierarchical text structural parsing. Thus, we propose Prism, a minimalist framework for hierarchical text detection. Prism performs multi-granularity detection by attaching parallel lightweight heads to a single-scale backbone feature map, covering words, text lines, and paragraphs, and reconstructs the structural hierarchy via an efficient geometric inclusion algorithm. In addition, we systematically compare representative lightweight head archetypes and show that pixel-level regression offers the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off in this setting. Experiments on multiple public benchmarks show that our significantly simplified architecture achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with remarkable efficiency. Specifically, it runs $1.7\times$ faster than LRANet on CTW1500 while achieving higher accuracy, and surpasses the current SOTA method, OmniParser V2, by over 6 PQ points on the hierarchical HierText dataset. Code will be released soon.
blocks.zh: 等级文本检测旨在解析文字,文本行和段落的结构关系的同时将它们本地化. 它为视觉文本的理解提供了必不可少的结构提示。 为了尽量精确,现有方法一般依赖于复杂的多尺度特征聚变颈部和重量级头部,导致结构膨胀,推论效率低. 在本文中,我们争辩说,经过充分训练的骨干可以有效地取代这些精密的外部模块,而简单的几何包含则足以进行等级文字结构解析. 因此,我们提出棱镜,一个分级文本检测的最低限度框架。 棱镜通过将平行的轻量级头部附加在单比例主干特征图上来进行多角度检测,覆盖文字,文字行和段落,并通过高效的几何融合算法重建结构层次. 此外,我们系统比较具有代表性的轻量级头型,并显示像素级回归在这个设定中提供了最佳的精度效率权衡. 对多种公共基准的实验表明,我们显著简化的建筑以显著的效率实现了最先进的(SOTA)性能. 具体地说,它在CTW1500上运行的1.7\times$比LIRNet快,同时实现了更高的精度,并且超过了目前SOTA方法OmniParser V2,在等级的HierText数据集上超过6PQ点. 代码很快就会发布

blocks.en: Text detection aims to localize textual instances in images. Hierarchical text detection goes one step further by detecting text at multiple granularities ( e.g. , words, lines, and paragraphs) and parsing their structural relationships. Such structured outputs provide richer layout information for text-rich natural scenes and electronic documents [ 10 , 11 ] . However, an efficient and accurate hierarchical text detection framework remains lacking, limiting its applicability in many real-world scenarios.
blocks.zh: 文本检测旨在将图像中的文本实例本地化. 分级文本检测更进一步,在多个颗粒体(如文字,行,段)中检测文本并解析其结构关系. 这种结构化的产出为内容丰富的自然场景和电子文件提供了更丰富的布局信息[10,11]. 然而,仍然没有有效和准确的分级文本检测框架,限制了其在许多现实世界情景中的适用性。

blocks.en:
To pursue higher accuracy, existing text detection methods typically adopt an “architectural stacking” paradigm at the expense of efficiency. Specifically, mainstream solutions rely on increasingly elaborate designs: 1) Complex Necks –the feature pyramid network (FPN) [ 21 ] and its variants ( e.g. , PANet [ 22 ] , BiFPN [ 32 ] ) have become the standard for handling multi-scale objects, and complex multi-scale deformable attention modules [ 50 , 43 ] have also been widely adopted; 2) Heavy-weight Heads –bottom-up methods leverage computationally intensive high-resolution heads for precise pixel-level prediction [ 20 , 48 , 42 ] , while top-down methods use multiple parallel heads [ 51 , 25 , 30 ] or global attention modules [ 2 , 29 , 35 ] to handle multi-scale text instances.
Furthermore, for hierarchical text detection, complex relation-reasoning modules, such as the explicit word-to-line and line-to-paragraph relationship modeling in LayoutFormer [ 18 ] ,
are typically needed to parse the structural inclusion across different text granularities.
blocks.zh:
为了追求更高的准确性,现有的文本检测方法通常采用“建筑堆叠”模式,而牺牲效率。 具体来说,主流解决方案依赖于日益精心设计: 1) 复杂的内链-特征金字塔网络(FPN)[21]及其变体(如PANet[22],BiFPN[32])已经成为处理多尺度物体的标准,复杂的多尺度可变形注意模块[50,43]也被广泛采用; 2) 重量头-自下而上的方法利用计算密集的高分辨率头进行精确的像素水平预测[20,48,42],而自上而下的方法则使用多个平行头[51,25,30]或全局注意模块[2,29,35]来处理多尺度文本实例.
此外,对于分级文本检测,复杂的关系推理模块,如布局Former [18] 中明确的字对行和行对段关系模型,
通常需要分析不同文本颗粒的结构包含。

blocks.en:
We depart from this complexity-first paradigm and instead revisit text detection from a minimalist perspective, exploring whether a simple architecture can be sufficient when backed by strong pre-training. In general object detection,
plain ViT [ 9 ] backbones pre-trained with MAE [ 13 ] have been shown to achieve competitive performance with simple multi-scale adaptation, as demonstrated by ViTDet [ 17 ] . This raises a natural question: can text detection be simplified even further? We base our minimalist design on three task-specific observations: 1) Text detection fundamentally targets a single foreground category composed of a finite set of structural primitives ( e.g. , strokes and characters). We thus hypothesize that a single-scale feature map from a sufficiently powerful, extensively pre-trained backbone is discriminative enough to render multi-scale fusion necks like FPN redundant. 2) Text detection is inherently a purely perceptual task that requires only intrinsic visual features of each text instance, without the need for complex semantic reasoning ( e.g. , differentiating headings from body text). Therefore, lightweight heads are likely sufficient for the final prediction. 3) The spatial layout of text inherently encodes its hierarchical inclusion. Thus, simple geometric calculations can naturally replace complex word-line-paragraph relation modules.
blocks.zh:
我们偏离了这种复杂性第一的范式,而是从最小化的角度重新审视文本检测,探讨一个简单的架构如果有强大的前期培训支持,是否就足够了。 一般的物体探测,
Plain ViT [9] 骨干在MAE [13] 的预训下被证明在简单的多尺度适应下实现了竞争性的性能,ViTDet [17] 证明了这一点. 这就提出了一个自然的问题:文本检测能否进一步简化? 我们的最小设计是基于三项具体任务: 1)文本检测从根本上针对一个由一组有限结构原始(如中风和字符)组成的单一前景类. 因此,我们假设,从一个足够强大、经过广泛训练的骨干上绘制的单一比例特征图具有歧视性,足以使像FPN这样的多比例聚变颈部变得多余。 2)文本检测本质上是一个纯粹的感知任务,只需要每个文本实例的内在视觉特征,而不需要复杂的语义推理(例如,区分标题和正文). 因此,轻量级头可能足以进行最后预测。 3) 文本的空间布局内在地编码其分级包容. 因此,简单的几何计算可以自然地取代复杂的单词行段关系模块.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Visualization of Prism. Like a prism refracting light, our framework decomposes a single-scale feature into a rich spectrum of hierarchical outputs, spanning words, lines, paragraphs, and their geometric layouts.
blocks.zh: 图2:棱镜的可视化. 像棱镜折射光一样,我们的框架将一个单级特征分解成丰富的层次输出谱,横跨文字,行,段落,以及它们的几何布局.

blocks.en: Building upon these insights, we propose Prism, a minimalist hierarchical text detection framework. True to its name, just as a prism refracts a single beam of light into a vibrant spectrum, Prism decomposes the single-scale feature into a diverse set of structural outputs, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . Specifically, it consists solely of a backbone and a set of parallel, lightweight expert heads built upon a single-scale feature map. Conceptually, this resembles a multi-expert architecture, with each head specializing in a specific task ( e.g. , word or line detection). Finally, we employ a box-approximation geometric inclusion algorithm to efficiently and accurately parse the hierarchical structure.
blocks.zh: 在这些见解的基础上,我们提出棱镜,一个最低等级文本检测框架。 和它的名字一样,正如棱镜将单束光线折射成一个充满活力的光谱一样,棱镜将单级特征分解成一组多样的结构输出,如Fig所示. 2 (英语). 具体而言,它完全由一个骨干和一套平行的轻量级专家头像组成,这些头像建立在单一比例的特征图上。 从概念上讲,这类似于多专家架构,每个头都专门从事特定任务(例如,单词或行检测). 最后,我们使用一个箱形近似几何包容算法来高效和准确地解析等级结构.

blocks.en: To fully realize this minimalist framework, the design of the lightweight head is crucial. Thus, we categorize and systematically analyze lightweight implementations of four head archetypes: pixel-level regression ( e.g. , YOLO-style [ 37 ] ), query-based regression ( e.g. , DETR-style [ 3 ] ), pixel-level segmentation ( e.g. , DB-style [ 19 ] ), and query-level segmentation ( e.g. , MaskFormer-style [ 5 ] ). Our study shows that a pixel-level regression head, which explicitly leverages spatial priors and perceives instances holistically, achieves the best balance of accuracy and efficiency.
blocks.zh: 为了充分实现这种最小化的框架,轻量级头部的设计是至关重要的. 因此,我们分类并系统分析四个头型的轻量级执行:像素级回归(如YOLO-style [37]),基于查询的回归(如DETR-style [3]),像素级分割(如DB-style [19]),以及查询级分割(如MaskFormer-style [5]). 我们的研究表明,一个像素级回归头,它明确利用空间前题和整体感知实例,实现了精度和效率的最佳平衡.

blocks.en: Owing to its minimalist design, Prism yields remarkable inference speed. As shown in Fig. 1 , Prism is 1.7 × 1.7\times faster than the leading real-time detector LRANet [ 31 ] while maintaining superior accuracy. Moreover, on the hierarchical dataset HierText [ 26 ] , our method surpasses the SOTA Omniparser V2 [ 45 ] by at least 6% in Panoptic Quality (PQ).
blocks.zh: 由于其最小化的设计,棱镜产生显著的推论速度. 如图1所示,棱镜比领先的实时探测器LIRSNet[31]快1.7×1.7\,同时保持优异的准确性. 此外,在分级数据集HierText [26]上,我们的方法在Panoptic Quality(PQ)中超过了SOTA Omniparser V2 [45] 至少6%.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are as follows:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce a minimalist design paradigm for unified hierarchical text detection, demonstrating that as backbone models and pre-training data scale up, complex multi-scale necks and heavy heads become increasingly redundant. • We propose Prism, a simple framework that couples single-scale multi-granularity detection with parameter-free geometric inclusion, enabling efficient word-line-paragraph hierarchy parsing without multi-scale necks or learnable relation modules. • Extensive experiments over multiple challenging benchmarks show that Prism achieves superior detection accuracy and computational efficiency despite its significantly simplified architecture.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们引入了统一分级文本检测的最小化设计范式,表明作为骨干模型和预训数据规模的提升,复杂的多级颈部和重头部变得日益冗余. 我们提出棱镜(Prism),一个简单的框架,夫妇用无参数的几何元素来进行单尺度的多角检测,使得高效的词行-段落层次解析没有多尺度的颈部或可学习的关系模块. • 对多重挑战性基准的广泛实验表明,棱镜尽管结构大大简化,但能达到更高的检测精度和计算效率。

blocks.en: We introduce a minimalist design paradigm for unified hierarchical text detection, demonstrating that as backbone models and pre-training data scale up, complex multi-scale necks and heavy heads become increasingly redundant.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了统一分级文本检测的最小化设计范式,表明作为骨干模型和预训数据规模的提升,复杂的多尺度颈部和重头部变得越来越多余.

blocks.en: We propose Prism, a simple framework that couples single-scale multi-granularity detection with parameter-free geometric inclusion, enabling efficient word-line-paragraph hierarchy parsing without multi-scale necks or learnable relation modules.
blocks.zh: 我们提出棱镜(Prism),一个简单的框架,夫妇用无参数的几何元素来进行单尺度的多角检测,使得高效的词行-段落层次解析没有多尺度的颈部或可学习的关系模块.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments over multiple challenging benchmarks show that Prism achieves superior detection accuracy and computational efficiency despite its significantly simplified architecture.
blocks.zh: 对多重挑战性基准的广泛实验表明,棱镜尽管其结构大大简化,但能达到更高的检测精度和计算效率。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Text detection has evolved from conventional document-oriented scenarios to more challenging in-the-wild settings, where text instances often exhibit arbitrary shapes, large scale variations, cluttered backgrounds, and complex illumination. According to the representation of text instances, existing methods can be broadly grouped into segmentation-based and regression-based approaches. We review these two families first, then discuss hierarchical text detection and recent minimalist detection designs that motivate our work.
blocks.zh: 文本检测已经从传统的面向文档的情景发展到更具挑战性的“万事通”设置,其中文本实例往往显示出任意的形状、大尺度的变异、杂乱的背景和复杂的照明。 根据文字实例的表述,现有方法可以大致分为分块法和回归法。 我们首先审查这两个家庭,然后讨论分级文本检测和最近激励我们工作的最小化检测设计。

blocks.en: 2.1 Segmentation-Based Text Detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 以分块为基础的文本检测

blocks.en: Segmentation-based methods, mainly inspired by instance segmentation [ 1 , 40 , 4 , 5 ] , treat text detection as a segmentation problem. These methods have evolved along two primary paradigms: bottom-up pixel-level classification and top-down query-level mask prediction.
blocks.zh: 基于分解的方法,主要受实例分解[1,40,4,5]的启发,将文本检测视为分解问题. 这些方法沿两个主要范式发展:自下而上的像素级分类和自上而下的查询级遮罩预测.

blocks.en:
Pixel-level segmentation approaches typically predict dense pixel-wise segmentation maps, which are then grouped into individual text instances. For example,
PSENet [ 39 ] reconstructs instance contours using a multi-scale kernel expansion strategy, while TextPMs [ 47 ] uses an iterative region growing algorithm. DB series [ 19 , 20 ] introduce a groundbreaking differentiable binarization module to simplify post-processing.
KAC [ 49 ] proposes a kernel adaptive convolution module to enhance segmentation results.
blocks.zh:
像素级分解方法一般预测密集的像素级分解图,然后归为单个文本例. 举例来说,
PSENet [39] 使用多比例内核扩展策略重建实例轮廓,而TextPMs [47] 则使用迭代区域生长算法. DB系列 [19, 20] 引入了具有突破性的不同二进制模块,以简化后处理.
科航[49]提出内核适应演化模块,以增强分化结果.

blocks.en: However, computationally intensive post-processing remains a bottleneck. For example, as shown in Fig. 1 , the post-processing stage of the highly-optimized DB++ [ 20 ] still accounts for more than 20% of the total inference time.
blocks.zh: 然而,计算密集的后处理仍然是一个瓶颈。 例如,如图1所示,高度优化的DB++[20]的后处理阶段仍然占总推断时间的20%以上.

blocks.en: Query-level segmentation approaches address the aforementioned limitations from a top-down perspective. Following the instance segmentation method MaskFormer [ 5 ] , they use a set of learnable object queries to predict the overall mask for each instance, and thus avoid the complex post-processing. For instance, DocSAM [ 16 ] introduces semantic queries to interact with standard instance queries to handle heterogeneous text detection, segmentation, and layout analysis tasks.
blocks.zh: 查询一级分解方法从自上而下的角度处理上述限制。 遵循实例分割法MaskFormer [5],他们使用一组可学习对象查询来预测每个实例的整体掩码,从而避免复杂的后处理. 例如,DocSAM [16] 引入语义查询与标准实例查询互动,处理不同文本检测、分区和布局分析任务。

blocks.en: However, while simplifying the post-processing, the quality of mask prediction depends heavily on complex multi-layered Transformer decoders and multi-scale fusion necks.
blocks.zh: 然而,在简化后处理的同时,面具预测的质量严重依赖于复杂的多层变形器解码器和多尺度的聚变颈.

blocks.en: 2.2 Regression-Based Text Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于递归的文本检测

blocks.en: Regression-based methods represent text instances as parameterized vectors for regression. Based on the positive sample assignment strategy, they can be divided into two main paradigms: pixel-level regression and query-level regression.
blocks.zh: 基于回归的方法代表文本实例作为回归的参数化矢量. 基于正样本分配策略,它们可以分为两个主要范式:像素级回归和查询级回归.

blocks.en:
Pixel-level regression approaches typically perform pixel-by-pixel regression on feature maps and then use non-maximum suppression (NMS) to filter redundant prediction results.
For example, ABCNet [ 23 ] adopts the Bernstein polynomial to transform the long sides of the text into Bezier curves, and performs regression using the FCOS [ 34 ] architecture. To fully exploit text shape relevance and reduce post-processing time, LRANet [ 31 ] proposes low-rank approximate text shape representations and a dual allocation strategy for positive samples.
blocks.zh:
像素级回归法一般在特征图上进行像素逐像素回归,然后使用非最大压制(NMS)来过滤多余的预测结果.
例如,ABCNet [23] 采用伯恩施泰因多边形将文本的长边转换成贝塞尔曲线,并使用FCOS [34] 架构进行回归. 为了充分利用文本形状的相关性和减少处理后的时间,LIRNet[31]提出了低排名的近似文本形状表述和正面样本的双重分配战略。

blocks.en: Query-level regression approaches, pioneered by DETR [ 3 ] , frame parameterized text shape regression as a set prediction problem with sparse positive samples, eliminating the need for NMS. For instance, DPText-DETR [ 43 ] proposes an explicit point-coordinate query modeling method to handle the varying scales and shapes of text instances. SRFormer [ 2 ] further introduces a segmentation branch in shallow layers to provide pixel-level priors.
blocks.zh: 由DETR [3] 开创的查询级回归方法,框架参数化的文本形状回归,作为带稀有正样本的一组预测问题,消除了NMS的需求. 例如,DPText-DETR [43] 提出了一个明确的点坐标查询模型方法,以处理文本实例的不同尺度和形状。 SRFormer [2] 进一步引入了浅层分块分支,以提供像素级前缀.

blocks.en: Although they eliminate NMS, this does not inherently lead to superior efficiency, as the complexity is transferred to the heavy-weight Transformer decoder itself, which must perform a similar function of redundancy removal through its self-attention modules.
blocks.zh: 虽然它们取消了NMS,但这在本质上并没有导致更高的效率,因为复杂性被转移到重量级变形器解码器本身,它必须通过其自留式模块来履行类似的冗余去除功能.

blocks.en: 2.3 Hierarchical Text Detection
blocks.zh: 2.3 等级文本检测

blocks.en:
Hierarchical text detection aims to detect multi-granularity text and then perform geometric layout analysis. UniDec [ 26 ] first proposes unifying scene text detection and geometric layout analysis, using a query-level segmentation-based method to predict words, lines, and paragraphs, and an affinity matrix to determine paragraph grouping. LayoutFormer [ 18 ] introduces a unified framework with three parallel Transformer decoders (for words, lines, and paragraphs, respectively), complemented by modules that explicitly model word-to-line and line-to-paragraph relationships. DAT [ 36 ] proposes a cross-granularity interactive attention module for multi-granularity text detection. Moreover,
OmniParser V2 [ 45 ] frames the task as a sequence generation problem, generating complete hierarchical relationships by inserting line and paragraph tags into its structured point sequences.
blocks.zh:
分级文本检测旨在检测多角文本,然后进行几何布局分析. UniDec [26]首先提出统一场景文本检测和几何布局分析,使用基于查询级的分区法来预测文字,行,段,以及亲和矩阵来决定段落分组. 布局Former [18] 引入了一个统一的框架,配有三个平行的变形器解码器(分别用于词,行,和段落),辅以明确模型化的逐行和逐行关系的模块. DAT[36]提出跨角交互关注模块,用于多角文字检测. 此外,
OmniParser V2 [45] 将任务设定为序列生成问题,通过在其结构化的点序列中插入线条和段落标记来产生完整的层次关系.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : The overview of our Prism . It consists of only two main components: a backbone and a set of parallel, lightweight heads. “Task-specific activation” denotes selectively activating a specific expert head based on the required task configuration.
blocks.zh: 图3:我们棱镜概览 它仅由两个主要部分组成:骨干和一组平行,轻量级的头. “特定任务启动”是指根据所需的任务组合有选择地激活特定专家负责人。

blocks.en: However, these approaches typically rely on complex multi-scale necks and heavy-weight heads, as well as intricate hierarchical modeling modules to reason about the relationships across different text granularities, leading to low efficiency, which is a core issue our work seeks to challenge.
blocks.zh: 然而,这些方法通常依赖复杂的多级颈部和重量级头部,以及复杂的层次模型模块来解释不同文本颗粒之间的关系,导致效率低下,这是我们的工作试图挑战的一个核心问题。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Minimalist Design Philosophy
blocks.zh: 3.1 最小设计哲学

blocks.en: Current text detection methods typically follow general object detection or segmentation paradigm, relying on multi-scale fusion necks to adapt to varying text scales and shapes, coupled with increasingly heavy-weight heads to refine predictions. However, this “complexity-first” consensus overlooks the first principles of text detection. Unlike general object detection, it is a single-category task without inter-class confusion, and image text is a structured visual pattern composed of a finite set of primitives such as strokes and characters.
blocks.zh: 目前的文字检测方法通常遵循一般物体检测或分化范式,依靠多尺度的聚变颈来适应不同的文字尺度和形状,同时加之重量越来越多的头来完善预测. 然而,这种“复杂第一”的共识忽略了文本检测的第一原则。 与一般对象检测不同,它是一个没有类间混淆的单类任务,图像文本是一个结构化的视觉图案,由一组有限的原始人,如中风和字符组成.

blocks.en: Based on these first principles, we hypothesize that these elaborately designed necks and heavy heads are essentially crutches devised to mitigate the weak representational power of less capable backbones or those with limited pre-training. With the emergence of more powerful backbones and the availability of large-scale pre-training, this complexity may no longer be necessary. Thus, a text detection model requires only two indispensable components: an extensively pre-trained backbone for extracting generic features and a set of heads for mapping those features to specific task outputs. Furthermore, for hierarchical text detection, learnable relation reasoning modules are unnecessary, as natural geometric calculations of spatial relationships are sufficient to parse the structural layout.
blocks.zh: 基于这些首要原则,我们假设这些精心设计的颈部和重头骨基本上是为减轻能力较弱的骨干或训练前训练有限的骨干代表力量薄弱而设计的拐杖。 随着更强大的骨干力量的出现和大规模预训的提供,这种复杂性可能不再需要. 因此,文本检测模型只需要两个不可或缺的组成部分:一个是经过广泛事先培训的用于提取通用特性的骨干骨干,另一个是一组用于将这些特性映射到具体任务产出上的头. 此外,对于分级文本检测,可以学习的关系推理模块是不必要的,因为空间关系的自然几何计算足以解析结构布局.

blocks.en: This hypothesis presents a critical design choice: whether to integrate these task heads into the backbone or to separate them. We argue strongly for their separation. A task-agnostic backbone can learn more universal representations, while separate, task-specific heads provide crucial modularity and flexibility. This decoupled design supports features like on-demand task activation and avoids the need to retrain the entire model when adding new tasks. Thus, our architectural blueprint is a single backbone followed by parallel, lightweight, and independent heads for different text granularities.
blocks.zh: 这个假设提出了一个关键的设计选择:是把这些任务负责人整合到骨干中还是分开. 我们强烈主张将他们分开。 一个任务不可知的主干部门可以学习更普遍的表述,而独立的、针对具体任务的主管则提供关键的模块性和灵活性。 这种脱钩的设计支持点播任务激活等功能,避免了在添加新任务时对整个模型进行再培训的需要. 因此,我们的建筑蓝图是一个单一的支柱, 后面是平行的,轻量级的, 和独立的头 不同的文本颗粒。

blocks.en: 3.2 Overall Framework
blocks.zh: 3.2 总框架

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Detailed architectures of the four lightweight head archetypes.
blocks.zh: 图4:四个轻量级头型拱门型的详细建筑.

blocks.en:
Following the design philosophy outlined above, the overall framework of Prism is radically simple, as illustrated in Fig. 3 .
Prism utilizes only the single-scale feature map from a single deep stage of the backbone as the unified entry point for all subsequent tasks. True to its name, the framework operates like an optical prism: it maps this single feature representation to a spectrum of structured outputs through parallel lightweight heads. We refer to these granularity-specific heads as Expert Heads, as each one is responsible for a particular output level, such as word, text-line, or paragraph detection.
Furthermore, a task-specific activation mechanism selectively routes features to the required heads, enabling flexible on-demand inference and targeted training on datasets with different annotations.
blocks.zh:
根据上述设计理念,棱镜的总体框架非常简单,如图3所示。
棱镜只使用从主干单深阶段的单比例特征图作为所有后续任务的统一切入点. 框架如光学棱镜般运作:它通过平行的轻量级头将这个单一的特征表现图映射到一系列结构化的输出. 我们将这些颗粒性特定头称为专家头,因为每个头都负责特定的输出级别,例如文字、文字线或段落检测。
此外,针对具体任务的启动机制有选择地将特征带入所需负责人,从而能够灵活地根据需求进行推论,并对有不同说明的数据集进行有针对性的培训。

blocks.en: Notably, the selection of an appropriate output feature scale is key to the success of this minimalist design. Standard hierarchical backbones produce feature maps at various downsampling rates ( e.g. , 4x, 8x, 16x, 32x). Deeper features ( e.g. , 32x), while semantically rich, have a low spatial resolution that is detrimental to localizing small text instances. Conversely, shallower features ( e.g. , 4x or 8x) significantly increase the computational overhead of the subsequent prediction heads due to their large spatial size. Therefore, we adopt the 16x downsampled feature map ( e.g. , the C4 stage of ResNet) as the sole feature source. This scale strikes an ideal balance between semantic abstraction and spatial resolution, while also allowing for the truncation of deeper backbone stages to further reduce computational cost without compromising performance.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,选择适当的产出特征规模是这种最小化设计成功的关键。 标准等级主干线以各种下采样速率制作特征图(如:4x,8x,16x,32x). 更深的特征(例如,32x)虽然精致丰富,但空间分辨率低,不利于小文本实例本地化. 相反,较浅的特征(如4x或8x)由于空间大小较大,大大增加了后续预测头的计算间接费用. 因此,我们采用16x下采样的特征图(例如ResNet的C4级)作为唯一的特征源. 这种比例表在语义抽象和空间分辨率之间达成理想的平衡,同时也允许缩短更深的骨干阶段,在不损害性能的情况下进一步降低计算成本.

blocks.en: Finally, we adopt simple geometric calculations to parse hierarchical relationships. However, iterative intersection operations on irregular text contours are highly time-consuming, especially for dense predictions. To ensure high efficiency, we approximate the text instances with their minimum bounding boxes and calculate their intersection-of-sets (IoS). Crucially, rather than relying on complex polygon intersections, we reconstruct the structural hierarchy through a bottom-up sequence of vectorized box-level IoS calculations, establishing the layout (from words to lines, then lines to paragraphs) with remarkable efficiency.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们采用简单的几何计算来分析等级关系。 然而,关于不规则文本轮廓的迭代交叉操作非常耗时,特别是对于密集的预测. 为确保高效,我们把文本实例与最小的边框相近,并计算其组合(IoS)。 关键是,我们不是依赖复杂的多边形交叉,而是通过向量化箱级IOS计算的一个自下而上的顺序来重建结构等级,建立布局(从文字到行,再到段落),效率显著.

blocks.en: 3.3 Lightweight Head Archetypes
blocks.zh: 3.3 轻量级头型

blocks.en: To identify a suitable lightweight head design for the proposed single-scale framework, we systematically explore four representative archetypes corresponding to mainstream detection paradigms.
blocks.zh: 为了为拟议的单比例框架确定合适的轻量级头部设计,我们系统地探索了与主流检测范式相对应的四种有代表性的型号.

blocks.en:
Pixel-level regression head. As shown in Fig. 4 (a), this head consists of two parallel branches: a classification branch and a regression branch. Each adopts two 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutional layers to extract task-specific features. Following the dual-path scheme in [ 31 ] , both branches are split into a dense text region (TR) path and a sparse sample region (SSR) path. The dense TR path provides ample supervision signals by treating all locations within the ground-truth text region as positive samples for contour coefficient regression, ensuring robust feature learning. In contrast, the sparse SSR path is dedicated to accelerating inference. Its positive samples are determined via the Hungarian algorithm, which strictly assigns one positive sample per instance to eliminate the time spent filtering redundant predictions.
For each granularity, the same regression branch and assignment strategy are applied independently, while the prediction targets are derived from the corresponding word-, line-, or paragraph-level annotations.
blocks.zh:
像素级回归头. 如图4(a)所示,这个头由两个平行分支组成:一个分类分支和一个回归分支. 每个都采用两个 3× 3 3\ 3\ 3 的演化层来提取任务特定特征. 遵循[31]中的双路径计划,两个分支被分为密集的文本区(TR)路径和稀疏的样本区(SSR)路径. 密集的TR路径通过将地面-真实文本区域内的所有地点作为轮廓系数回归的正样本,提供了充分的监督信号,确保扎实的特征学习。 与此相对照,安全部门改革的路径稀少,是为了加快推论。 它的阳性标本是通过匈牙利算法确定的,该算法严格地每个实例分配一个阳性标本,以消除为过滤多余预测所花费的时间.
对于每个颗粒,相同的回归分支和分配策略独立应用,而预测目标则来自相应的单词,行,或段落级说明.

blocks.en: Pixel-level segmentation head. As shown in Fig. 4 (b), this head first upscales the input features by 4 × \times to recover spatial details, followed by two 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutional layers for refinement. Following [ 49 ] , we predict four parallel maps: a text segmentation (TR) map, a distance map, and two pixel-wise direction maps (X and Y). The direction maps serve as auxiliary supervision during training to separate adjacent instances. During inference, only the TR and distance maps are utilized. Specifically, the text center region is extracted by thresholding the distance map, while the TR map acts as auxiliary information to filter false positives. Finally, these preserved centers are expanded to reconstruct the text contours.
blocks.zh: 象素级分片头. 如图4(b)所示,这个头首先将输入特征提升为4××\时以恢复空间细节,然后是2个3×3 3×3×时3进化层以进行改进. 在 [49] 之后,我们预测四张平行地图:一张文本分割图(TR),一张距离图,以及两张像素偏导方向图(X和Y). 方向图在为相邻的个别情况提供培训期间作为辅助监督。 在推论期间,只使用TR和距离图. 具体来说,文本中心区域是通过阈值距离图来提取的,而TR地图则起到辅助信息的作用来过滤假阳性. 最后,这些保存下来的中心被扩大以重建文字轮廓.

blocks.en: Query-level regression head. As shown in Fig. 4 (c), this head adopts an encoder-only DETR-like paradigm. It first employs a lightweight convolutional branch to predict the top- k k ( e.g. , top-100) most salient center points from the feature map F F . These points are then encoded as a set of learnable queries with discriminative positional cues. To simplify the structure, these queries are concatenated with the flattened feature map F F to form a single, composite input sequence, enabling a “dual-path” optimization within a unified Transformer Encoder consisting of three layers. Specifically, unlike conventional DETR-like structures that utilize an encoder for visual features followed by a decoder for query refinement, our design achieves both functions within the single encoder. This structure allows the queries to attend to the full context of F F while simultaneously refining F F ’s own representations, effectively achieving an implicit cross-attention. This strategic simplification eliminates the need for a separate, heavyweight Transformer Decoder. Finally, the output features corresponding to the refined queries are fed into two parallel linear layers to generate the final classification and regression results.
blocks.zh: 查询级回归头 。 如图4(c)所示,此头采用只编码器的DETR式样. 它首先使用一个轻量级的演化分支来预测地物图F F中最突出的中心点-k k(如:Top-100). 这些分数随后编码为一组带有歧视性位置提示的可学习查询. 为了简化结构,这些查询与平整的特征图F F 相配合,形成一个单一的,复合的输入序列,使得在由三层组成的统一的变形器编码器内能够实现“双路径”优化. 具体来说,与常规的DETR类似结构不同,它使用一个编码器来进行视觉特性,然后用一个解码器来改进查询,我们的设计在单一编码器内实现了两种功能. 这种结构使查询能够处理F F的全部情况,同时完善F F自己的表述,有效地实现隐含的交叉注意。 这种战略简化消除了单独一个重量级变形器解码器的需求. 最后,与精细的查询对应的输出特征被输入两个平行的线性层,以产生最终的分类和回归结果.

blocks.en: Query-level segmentation head. As shown in Fig. 4 (d), this head adopts an encoder-only paradigm similar to that of our query-level regression head (Fig. 4 (c)). The key distinction lies in the output stage, where the regression branch is replaced by a MaskFormer-style segmentation module. Specifically, the refined query features are fed into a Linear layer for classification and an MLP to generate mask embeddings. Concurrently, the refined visual features are upscaled by 4 × \times to serve as high-resolution pixel embeddings. The final segmentation masks are generated via the dot product of the query-specific mask embeddings and the pixel embeddings. Notably, to accelerate convergence, the convolutional center-point prediction branches in both query-level heads (Fig. 4 (c)(d)) are initialized with pre-trained weights from the pixel-level segmentation head.
blocks.zh: 查询级分区头. 如图4(d)所示,本标题采用了与我们的查询级回归头(图4(c))相似的仅编码器模式。 关键区别在于输出阶段,即回归分支被MaskFormer风格的分块模块所取代. 具体来说,精细的查询功能被输入到一个线性层进行分类,和一个MLP生成面具嵌入. 同时,精细的视觉特征被提升为4×\时,作为高分辨率像素嵌入. 最终的分区面具是通过查询专用面具嵌入和像素嵌入的点产品生成的. 值得注意的是,为了加速趋同,两个查询级头(图4(c)(d))的演化中心点预测分支都以像素级片段头预先训练的权重初始化.

blocks.en: Accordingly, we use the pixel-level regression head in Prism, with detailed quantitative justification provided in Sec. 4.4 .
blocks.zh: 因此,我们在棱镜中使用像素级回归头,详细量化论证见4.4节。

blocks.en: 3.4 Optimization and Post-processing
blocks.zh: 3.4 优化和后处理

blocks.en: Mixed-Granularity Training. To effectively train our unified model on diverse datasets that often contain incomplete annotations (e.g., some datasets provide only word-level labels, while others provide only line-level labels), we adopt a mixed-granularity training strategy. The total training objective L L is defined as the conditional sum of task-specific losses L t L_{t} for each granularity t ∈ T = { word , line , paragraph } t\in T=\{\text{word},\text{line},\text{paragraph}\} : L = ∑ t ∈ T ω t ⋅ L t . L=\sum_{t\in T}\omega_{t}\cdot L_{t}. Here, ω t \omega_{t} is a binary indicator set to 1 if the ground-truth for granularity t t is present in the current sample, and 0 otherwise. This conditional objective allows Prism to seamlessly leverage datasets with incomplete or single-granularity annotations, while producing multi-granularity predictions within a unified model. In addition, the trained model can infer missing granularities on datasets without complete hierarchical labels, making it useful for pseudo-label generation.

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: HierText [ 26 ] is a large-scale dataset featuring hierarchical annotations for word, text-line, and paragraph positions. It contains 8,281 training, 1,724 validation, and 1,634 test images. Total-Text [ 7 ] is a key arbitrary-shaped text benchmark, containing 1,000 training and 255 test images. CTW1500 [ 24 ] is another arbitrary-shaped benchmark, providing 1,000 training and 500 test images annotated at the text-line level. MSRA-TD500 [ 41 ] is a multi-oriented dataset with 300 training and 200 test images. ArT [ 6 ] is a large-scale arbitrary-shaped text detection dataset, containing 5603 5603 training images and 4563 4563 test images. Synth150K [ 23 ] is a synthetic pre-training dataset, comprising about 150K images. ICDAR 2013 (IC13) [ 15 ] is a horizontal dataset that contains 229 229 training and 233 233 test images. ICDAR 2015 (IC15) [ 14 ] is a multi-oriented dataset with 1,000 training and 500 test images, labeled at the word-level. ICDAR17 MLT (MLT17) [ 27 ] is a large multi-language dataset providing 9,000 images for training. TextOCR [ 28 ] is a large real-world scene text dataset, composed of 21,749 training, 3,153 validation, and 3,232 test images.

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节

blocks.en:
We utilize a simplified ResNet50-DCN backbone, truncated after the C4 stage, and adopt the pixel-level regression head (Fig. 4 (a)) as our default Expert Head. During training, we pre-train for 450K iterations on a mixture of Synth150K, IC13, IC15, MLT17, and TextOCR, using an ABCNet v2 recognition head for joint training. We use the AdamW optimizer (batch size 16) with an initial learning rate of 0.0001, which is decayed by a factor of 0.1 at 375K iterations. Then, we fine-tune for 300 epochs on each evaluated dataset.
Data augmentations include RandomCrop , RandomRotate , RandomFlip , and ColorJitter . During inference, we resize the short sides of the input images to 704 704 , 1000 1000 , 800 800 , 1600 1600 , and 2048 2048 for CTW1500, Total-Text, MSRA-TD500, ArT, and HierText, respectively, while keeping the original aspect ratio. blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison with State-of-the-art Methods
blocks.zh: 4.3 与最新技术的比较 方法

blocks.en: Single-granularity Text Detection. We evaluate the performance of Prism on the most widely used benchmarks for single-granularity scene text detection, i.e. , MSRA-TD500 and CTW1500 for text-line detection, and Total-Text and ArT for word detection. As shown in Table 1 , Prism consistently demonstrates top-tier performance across these datasets. Specifically, on MSRA-TD500, our method outperforms the leading method MTD [ 12 ] by 1.1% (92.3% vs. 91.2%) in F-measure. On the arbitrary-shaped text benchmarks ArT and Total-Text, Prism also achieves SOTA performance with F-measures of 81.1% and 91.2%, respectively. Most importantly, Prism exhibits a significant advantage in inference speed. Benefiting from its minimalist design, it runs at 65.1 FPS on CTW1500, which is 1.7 × 1.7\times faster than LRANet and 7.9 × 7.9\times faster than SRFormer, establishing a new optimal trade-off between accuracy and efficiency.

blocks.en: Hierarchical Text Detection. We compare Prism with existing frameworks on the challenging HierText test and validation sets (Table 2 ). Despite its minimalist design, Prism achieves a significant lead over existing methods that rely on complex architectures. On the test set, Prism surpasses the SOTA OmniParser V2 by substantial margins across all hierarchical levels: +14.2% in Word PQ (75.8 vs. 61.6), +6.6% in Line PQ (71.1 vs. 64.5), and +11.6% in Paragraph PQ (66.8 vs. 55.2). This gap stems primarily from three factors (with detailed ablations in Sec. 4.4 ). First, hierarchical relationships can be naturally derived from detection outputs (words, lines, paragraphs) through simple post-processing. Unlike methods such as LayoutFormer [ 18 ] that use relationship prediction modules and thus risk propagating cumulative errors, we obtain them by directly calculating the intersection-of-sets (IoS) between the minimum bounding boxes of the level-specific predictions, which is also highly efficient due to parallelization. Second, previous methods all adopt query-level heads; however, pixel-level heads have clear superiority over query-based ones for this task. Finally, our lightweight architecture allows us to efficiently adopt high-resolution inputs ( S = 2048 S=2048 ). This is crucial because HierText contains a massive number of dense, small text instances that require high resolution for accurate detection.
blocks.zh: 分级文本检测. 我们比较棱镜与关于具有挑战性的HierText测试和验证集的现有框架(表2)。 尽管其最小化的设计,棱镜在依靠复杂架构的现有方法上取得了显著的领先. 在测试中,棱柱在所有等级中以相当大的幅度超过了SOTA OmniParser V2:Word PQ(75.8对61.6)+14.2%,PQ线(71.1对64.5)+6.6%,PQ段(66.8对55.2)+11.6%。 这一差距主要来自三个因素(详见第4.4节)。 首先,分级关系可以通过简单的后处理从检测输出(词,行,段落)中自然产生. 与布局Former[18]等使用关系预测模块从而冒着传播累积误差的风险的方法不同,我们通过直接计算各级别特定预测最小边框之间的相交点(IoS)来获得这些误差,由于并行性,同样高效. 第二,以前的方法都采用查询级头;然而,像素级头对于这个任务来说,明显优于查询级头. 最后,我们的轻量级架构使我们能够有效地采用高分辨率输入(S=2048 S=2048 ). 这一点至关重要,因为HierText包含大量密集,小的文本实例,需要高分辨率才能准确检测.

blocks.en:
Pre-training. Compared to the leading real-time method LRANet [ 31 ] , Prism adopts a lighter head, discards the FPN, and truncates the backbone at C4.
As shown in Table 4 , when training from scratch, Prism lags LRANet by 1.6 % 1.6\% in F-measure. This deficit arises because all representation pressure is concentrated onto the single C4 feature map, demanding sufficient pre-training to learn robust representations for varying text scales and shapes. Thus, with more pre-training data, the performance gap incrementally shrinks. Crucially, our model surpasses LRANet when utilizing End-to-End (E2E) Training (joint training with a recognition head), achieving an F-measure of 91.2 % 91.2\% compared to LRANet’s 91.0 % 91.0\% . This is attributed to the fine-grained semantic information introduced by E2E training, which compels the heavily tasked C4 feature to become more discriminative. We further verify this finding on Vision Transformer (ViT) architectures using the challenging HierText dataset. As shown in Table 7 (b), when using a ViT-B backbone without pre-training,
Prism noticeably underperforms LRANet. Yet, under the full pre-training setup, Prism closes this gap, matching or slightly exceeding LRANet across all hierarchical levels. Overall, these experiments demonstrate that rich pre-training (including both training data and training paradigms) is the essential prerequisite for our minimalist architecture.

blocks.en: Backbone Capacity. We evaluate our hypothesis that a powerful backbone is the core prerequisite for minimalist design across both CNN and Transformer architectures. As shown in Table 4 , when employing lighter backbones such as ResNet18 and ResNet50, Prism’s F-measure significantly lags LRANet. This deficit is mainly due to insufficient feature representation ability in these backbones, where LRANet’s multi-scale neck and multi-layer heads act as compensatory mechanisms to cover this shortfall. However, as the backbone is enhanced, these compensatory mechanisms become redundant, as our method achieves comparable performance with LRANet when using ResNet50-DCN. Crucially, our minimalist architecture maintains a substantial efficiency advantage, requiring less than half the parameters and GFLOPs of LRANet while delivering a 1.7 × \times inference speedup (65.1 vs. 37.2 FPS). Interestingly, further scaling to ResNet101-DCN yields negligible gains for both methods, suggesting ResNet50-DCN already provides sufficient feature discriminativeness for the purely perceptual task of text detection. This scaling law generalizes to Vision Transformers (Table 7 (a)): while Prism noticeably trails LRANet with a ViT-T backbone ( 66.7 % 66.7\% vs. 69.8 % 69.8\% Word PQ), scaling to ViT-B entirely eliminates this gap, confirming that a capable backbone intrinsically renders sophisticated necks obsolete.
blocks.zh: 后骨容量. 我们评价我们的假设,一个强大的骨干是整个CNN和变形金刚建筑最小化设计的核心先决条件. 如表4所示,在使用ResNet18和ResNet50等较轻的骨干时,Prism的F计量大大落后于LIRNet。 这种不足主要是由于这些骨干部门缺乏特征代表能力,而上帝军网的多层次颈部和多层次头部是弥补这一不足的补偿机制。 然而,由于主干得到加强,这些补偿机制变得多余,因为我们的方法在使用ResNet50-DCN时实现了与LIRNet的可比性能. 关键是,我们的最低限度结构保持了相当大的效率优势,在提供1.7xxxx时间推算速度(65.1 vs 37.2 FPS)的同时,需要不到一半的参数和LIRNet的GFLOP. 有趣的是,进一步向ResNet101-DCN的扩展使这两种方法的收益微不足道,这表明ResNet50-DCN已经为纯概念性的文本检测任务提供了足够的特征歧视。 这种缩放定律概括到视觉变换器(表7(a)):虽然棱镜明显跟踪了具有ViT-T主干线的LIRNet(66.7%66.7\%=69.8\%=69.8\%Word PQ),缩放到ViT-B完全消除了这一差距,证实一个有能力的骨干内在使精密的颈部变得过时.

blocks.en:
Expert Head. In Table 7 , we evaluate four
lightweight head archetypes discussed in Sec. 3.3 . To accommodate the massive number of dense text instances in HierText, we set the number of queries in query-level heads to 500, 300, and 100 for word, line, and paragraph detection, respectively. However, query-level heads consistently and substantially underperform their pixel-level counterparts. This is primarily because optimizing such a large set of queries for tiny, densely packed instances remains a significant challenge. Moreover, the global interaction of query-level heads offers limited benefits for this purely perceptual task, as text detection mainly relies on local patterns rather than contextual reasoning. Such interaction may be more suitable for logical layout analysis ( e.g. , distinguishing footers from body text). In contrast, pixel-level heads can fully leverage the explicit local spatial priors on the feature map, which is better suited to text detection. Of the two pixel-level variants, the regression head has a clear advantage, achieving the highest performance across all granularities: Word (75.8 PQ), Line (71.1 PQ), and Paragraph (66.8 PQ). This superiority is mainly because of its holistic instance perception. Compared to the complex bottom-up pixel grouping required by Pixel-Seg, holistic regression is a more natural and effective paradigm for predicting boundaries directly from the highly abstract C4 feature map. Consequently, we adopt Pixel-Reg as the default head instantiation for Prism.
blocks.zh:
专家头目. 在表7中,我们评价4个
轻量级头型在3.3节中讨论. 为了适应HierText中大量密集的文本实例,我们把查询层头的查询数分别设定为500,300和100,用于文字,行,段落检测. 然而,查询级头头一贯和大大低于其像素级对等者。 这主要是因为优化如此大量的对小的、密集的事例的查询仍然是一个重大挑战。 此外,查询级头的全球互动为这一纯粹的感知性任务提供了有限的好处,因为文本检测主要依赖于本地模式而不是背景推理. 这种相互作用可能更适合逻辑布局分析(例如,区分脚跟和正体文本). 相比之下,像素级别的头可以充分发挥特征图上明确的地方空间前缀的作用,这更适合文本检测. 在两个像素级变体中,回归头具有明显的优势,在所有颗粒体中都取得了最高的性能:Word(75.8 PQ),Line(71.1 PQ),和Pro段(66.8 PQ). 这种优越性主要是因为其整体性实例感. 与像素-Seg所要求的复杂的自下而上的像素组比起来,整体回归是直接从高度抽象的C4特征图中预测边界的更自然有效的范式. 因此,我们采用像素-Reg作为棱镜的默认头即兴.

blocks.en: Hierarchy Parsing. As Table 10 shows, due to hierarchical inclusion being naturally encoded in spatial layouts, simple geometric post-processing yields inherently higher accuracy than a strong learnable module (illustrated in Fig. 5 ). Specifically, we construct this strong baseline to explicitly model the structural hierarchy. It first selects top-scoring initial predictions and constructs queries by injecting level-specific embeddings and positional encodings. These queries are then iteratively refined through a complex decoding block repeated 6 times. Each block comprises independent self-attention within each granularity, unified self-attention to model cross-granularity context, and cross-attention interacting with the backbone feature map. Finally, the features of adjacent levels ( e.g. , word-line and line-paragraph pairs) are fused via element-wise multiplication and processed by an MLP-based relation head to explicitly predict their affiliations. However, such an intricate design is redundant and prone to cumulative errors.
blocks.zh: 分级剖析. 如表10所示,由于在空间布局中自然地编码了分级包容,简单的几何处理后输出的精度在本质上高于一个强大的可学习模块(在图5中被忽略)。 具体地说,我们构建了这个强有力的基线,以明确模拟结构等级。 它首先通过注射级特异性嵌入和位置编码来选择得分最高的初始预测和构建查询. 然后通过一个复杂的解码块重复了6次,对这些查询进行迭代改进. 每个区块包括每个颗粒内的独立自留,统一自留,用于建模跨角上下文,以及与主干特征图的交叉自留互动. 最后,相邻电位的特征(例如,单线和直线段对)通过元素相乘方式被熔化,并由基于MLP的关系头处理,以明确预测它们的隶属关系. 然而,这种复杂的设计是多余的,容易出现累积错误。

blocks.en: Instead of relying on heavyweight learnable modules, we leverage geometric calculations. However, since text instances are arbitrarily shaped, directly computing exact polygon intersections (Polygon-level IoS) is highly time-consuming. By adopting the Box-level IoS approximation, the accuracy loss is practically negligible ( e.g. , only a 0.1% drop in Line PQ). To further validate the effectiveness of the box-level approximation, we compare polygon-level and box-level IoU computation in NMS on a highly curved subset of CTW1500, following the subset definition in [ 29 ] . As shown in Table 10 , box-level IoU achieves nearly identical detection performance to polygon-level IoU, indicating that the box approximation introduces negligible accuracy loss even in this challenging setting. More importantly, this approximation transforms complex geometric calculations into parallelized matrix operations, substantially improving the processing speed and reducing latency to 1.2 ms.
blocks.zh: 我们不依靠重量级的可学习模块,而是利用几何计算。 然而,由于文本实例是任意塑造的,直接计算精确的多边形交叉点(Polygon-level IoS)是非常费时的. 通过采用箱级IoS近似法,精度损失几乎可以忽略不计(例如,PQ线只下降0.1%). 为了进一步验证盒级近似值的有效性,我们按照[29]中的子集定义,将NMS中多边形级和盒级IoU计算在CTW1500高度曲线化子集上进行比较. 如表10所示,箱级IoU实现与多边形级IoU几乎相同的检测性能,表明箱型近似即使在这种具有挑战性的设置中也会引入可忽略不计的精度损失. 更重要的是,这种近似将复杂的几何计算转化为平行的矩阵操作,大幅提高处理速度,并将耐久性降低到1.2 ms.

blocks.en: Unified vs. Separate. In Table 10 , we compare our unified learning paradigm against training three independent models for word, line, and paragraph detection, respectively. The unified model consistently outperforms the separate baseline across all metrics. We attribute this to two factors: 1) Hierarchical Synergy: Text entities exhibit inherent physical inclusion constraints ( e.g. , lines encompass words). Joint training allows the model to implicitly internalize these constraints, utilizing high-level context to verify and refine low-level detections. 2) Geometric Consistency: Since layout analysis depends heavily on the spatial alignment between granularities, sharing a unified feature encoder ensures that predictions for words and lines are spatially coherent, thereby reducing matching errors. Furthermore, the unified framework is inherently more concise and parameter-efficient.
blocks.zh: 统一对分别. 在表10中,我们比较了我们的统一学习模式与培训三个独立模式,即文字、行和段落检测。 统一模型的绩效始终高于所有指标的单独基线。 我们将此归因于两个因素: 1) 等级协同:文本实体表现出固有的物理包容限制(例如,行包含单词). 联合培训使该模式可以含蓄地将这些制约因素内化,利用高级别背景来核实和完善低水平检测。 2)几何一致性:由于布局分析很大程度上依赖于颗粒体之间的空间对齐,所以共享一个统一的特征编码器可以保证对词和线的预测在空间上的一致性,从而减少匹配错误. 此外,统一框架本身就更加简洁和具有参数效率。

blocks.en:
Choice of Backbone Feature Map. In Table 11 , we investigate the optimal single-scale feature map from the ResNet50-DCN backbone by comparing the C 3 C_{3} , C 4 C_{4} , and C 5 C_{5} outputs. As observed, the high-resolution C 3 C_{3} feature map yields a lower paragraph-level F-measure due to its limited receptive field. Conversely, the C 5 C_{5} feature map suffers from a lower word-level F-measure owing to its low spatial resolution. The C 4 C_{4} feature map effectively balances resolution and receptive field, achieving the highest F-measure across all granularities. Interestingly, while C 5 C_{5} achieves a higher paragraph F-measure than C 3 C_{3} (77.3 vs. 74.9), its paragraph Panoptic Quality (PQ) is actually lower (61.1 vs. 62.2). This discrepancy occurs because C 5 C_{5} ’s low resolution drastically degrades word-level detection, which subsequently propagates errors up the bottom-up hierarchical parsing.
Additionally, extracting C 5 C_{5} requires deeper backbone computations, whereas C 3 C_{3} imposes a heavy computational burden on the detection heads due to its large spatial dimensions. As a result, the centrally positioned C 4 C_{4} achieves the fastest inference speed. In summary, C 4 C_{4} serves as the optimal compromise between accuracy and efficiency.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 7 , we first visualize the multi-granularity detection results on the HierText test set. In complex document layouts or natural scenes with dense, small text instances, Prism accurately localizes visual text across words, lines, and paragraphs, and parses their topological inclusion relationships via the proposed Box-level IoS algorithm. This demonstrates that minimalist geometric post-processing can effectively replace heavy relation-reasoning modules.
blocks.zh: 如图7所示,我们首先在HierText测试集上可视化多角度检测结果。 在复杂文档布局或自然场景中,有密集的,小的文本实例,棱镜精确地将视觉文本定位于文字,行,段落之间,并通过拟议的Box级IoS算法来解析其地形包容性关系. 这表明,最小化几何处理后可有效取代重度关系推理模块。

blocks.en: Furthermore, we evaluate Prism on standard single-granularity scene text detection benchmarks, including CTW1500, Total-Text, ICDAR19 ArT, and MSRA-TD500. As shown in Fig. 8 , our method accurately detects text instances that exhibit challenging attributes, such as extreme length, high curvature, vertical orientation, or tiny scales. In particular, on CTW1500, tiny text instances are precisely localized even at a short-side resolution of 704. This robust performance demonstrates that our single-scale feature representation captures sufficient discriminative details to handle diverse shapes and scales without requiring multi-scale feature pyramids.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们还根据标准单角场景文本检测基准评估棱镜,包括CTW1500、Total-Text、ICDAR19 ArT和MSRA-TD500。 如图8所示,我们的方法准确地检测了显示具有挑战性的属性的文本实例,例如极长、高曲率、垂直方向或微小的尺度。 特别是,在CTW1500上,即使是在704的短方解析中,微小的文本实例也是精确本地化的. 这种强劲的表现表明,我们的单一比例特征表现能够捕捉到足够的歧视性细节,可以处理不同的形状和比例,而不需要多比例特征金字塔。

blocks.en: Benefiting from our mixed-granularity training strategy, Prism exhibits strong generalization capabilities. While many existing datasets only provide single-granularity annotations, Prism can seamlessly predict the missing hierarchical levels. As illustrated in Fig. 7 , it can generate precise word-level boundaries for highly stylized and dense text, accurately group scattered elements into coherent lines, and successfully cluster multiple lines into logical paragraphs despite complex background interference. This capability significantly enhances the practical value of our model, enabling the automatic refinement of incomplete annotations in real-world applications.
blocks.zh: 棱镜从我们的混合角力训练战略中受益,显示出强大的通俗化能力。 虽然许多现有的数据集只提供单格性说明,但棱晶可以无缝地预测缺失的等级级别. 如图7所示,它可以为高度结构化和密集的文本产生精确的字位边界,将分散的元素精确地组合成连贯的行,并在复杂的背景干扰下成功将多行组合成逻辑段落. 这种能力大大提高了我们模型的实际价值,使得能够自动完善现实世界应用中的不完整说明.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose Prism, a minimalist hierarchical text detection framework. By systematically re-evaluating the necessity of complex architectural components, we demonstrate that a single-scale feature map, empowered by a sufficiently powerful and extensively pre-trained backbone, can provide a competitive and efficient alternative to traditional multi-scale necks and heavy heads. Moreover, our empirical study of four lightweight head archetypes concludes that a simple pixel-level regression head provides the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off for this setting. To parse the multi-granularity relationships, Prism reconstructs the structural hierarchy through a simple yet highly efficient geometric inclusion algorithm. Given its extreme simplicity, we hope that Prism can naturally serve as a plug-and-play detection extension for emerging large vision-language models (VLMs) and encourages future research to shift focus from intricate architectural engineering toward a deeper exploration of backbone networks and pre-training.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出棱镜,一个最小的等级文本检测框架. 通过系统地重新评价复杂的建筑构件的必要性,我们表明,一个具有足够强大和经过广泛培训的骨干力量的单一比例特征图,能够提供一种有竞争力和高效率的替代办法,取代传统的多比例颈和重头。 此外,我们对四种轻量级头型的实证研究得出结论,简单的像素级回归头为这种设定提供了最佳的精确效率权衡. 为了解析多角度关系,棱镜通过简单而高效的几何融合算法重建结构等级. 我们希望棱镜能够自然地成为新兴大型视觉语言模型(VLM)的插座和游戏探测扩展,
